book.name: Yohana
book.title: Lijambu la Amboni ngati ejuandiki Yohana

content: Yesu juyokiti
Lisoba la jumapili pulukela, ekwabiya kwakona nga na kusaki, Malia juku Magidala jajenda ku lipole. Ejahika kola jilikolila lilibu lebayekali lipole lela aliboiki.
Ndienu jajenda imbelu kwaka Simoni Petili na mmbole jongi jojuwe Yesu ampaliki ngamaa, jaapwagila, “Amboiki Bambu mu litenge, wala ngasetumanyiki koambeile.”
Ndipala Simoni Petili na mmbolee jongi jola bajendannya kulitenge.
Boti abeli babia abutukani lakini jongi jola jabia jubutuka kupeta Petili, jalonguliya kuhika ku lipole.
Jajinama nukulingali nkati, jijibona ingobu nhuu seahingalaki nhyega jaka Yesu lakini ngasejajingala nkate.
Simoni Petili najombi jahika munyuma jaki nu kujingii mlipoli momuje jikibona ingobu nhuu jela.
Ni kitamba sebabia anyonalati Yesu kumutu. Kitambaa se hesi abei patali na sanda, ila sabia kitulwini kibii pakajika jaki.
Ndienu mmbolee waki jojalonguliya kuhika kulipoli jola najombi jajingala nkati nukubona itamba ye bahingalati nhyega jaka Yesu, nukuhobale.
Babia bakoni ngakuelewa Maandiku ga Sapi egapwaga kwabi, jupalika juyoka.
Ndipala banafunzi bala babujaniya kumajumba gabu.
Yesu ampiti Malia juku Magadala
Malia juku magadala jabia jujemiki kunza jilipoli jakalela. Ejwabiya jakoni jakalela jajinama nukulinga nkati jilipoli,
jaabona atumi abeli bu kunani baka Sapanga aweti ingobu iyuu, atamani pababei nhyega jaka Yesu pwabiya ajigoniki, jumu upandi ukumutu na jongi upandi wa kwamagolu.
Bundalukiya, “Nyongoo gulele kike?” Na Malia jaapwagila “Amboiki Bambu wango na wala ngasenukumanyiki koambeile!”
Malia pajajomula kupwaga haga, njang'anumbuka munyuma ambona Yesu jujemiki, lakini ngaseamanyike ngati jombi ndi Yesu.

Yesu ampwagila, “Nyongoo, gulele kike? Guntaputa nyane?” Malia jaholaliya julongee na jojuhenga lihengu lukulingali kijongu, ampwagila, “Nkolongu, ana gumboiki wehapa gumbwagila kogumbeile nane nukunzukuaje.”
Yesu ampwagila, “Malia!” Ndipala Malia anng'anambukiya Yesu nu kulongee naku kwi kiebulania, “Laboni!” Maana jaki Mmbola.

Yesu ampwagila, “Wingamu, nakonaa ngasembiti kunani kwa Atati. Lakini jenda kwaka alongu bangu ukaapwagila, nyenda kunani kwaka Sapanga kwa Atati bangu na Atati binu, Sapanga wangu na ndi Sapanga winu.”
Ndienu Malia juku Magidala jajenda kaapwagi majambu gala banafunzi kupwaga ambweni Bambu, najabiya ampwagi malobi haga.
Yesu jaapiti banafunzi baki

Kwabiya pakamii ji lisoba alelale la juma pili, banafunzi baki pababiya pamu nkati ju nyumba, milyangu babia apungiki ndaba jakajogopa akakiliongosi ba Ayaudi, Yesu jaapitila, jajema pikilanda jabu nukupwaaga, “Lukwali lubiya kwinu.”
Ejajomula kupwaga haga, jaalangia maboku gaki nu luteta lwaki. Banafunzi baki batogulii ngamaa pabummbona Bambu.
Yesu jaapwagila kabee, “Lukwali lubiya kwinu! Ngati Atati ebantuma nepani, nane numtuma mwanganya.”
Najombi ejajomula kupwaaga haga, jaapulaliya loho nakaapwagi, “Nzoopannya Loho jaka Sapanga.
Anamwalekaki bandu mahakau gabu, alekakiwi, anangakaalekake, ngabilekakiwe.”
Yesu na Tomasi
Lakini Tomasi, jobunkema, “Lipaa,” Jojabii jumu ja banafunzi baki komi na abeli, ngasejabii pamu nabu kipindi Yesu ejahika.

Henu banafunzi bangi bumpwagila, “Tumbweni Bambu.” Lakini jombi Tomasi jaapwagila, “Anangakagabona mabanga gi misumali mumaboku gaki nukubeka lukonzi lwagu mumabanga gimisumali nukuboku kwaku muluteta jaki, nganhobalele.”
Egapeta masoba nani banafunzi baki babiya kabee pamu mu nyumba, najombi Tomasi jabii pamu naku. Ndienu Yesu jahika koni milyangu apungiki nu kujema pikilanda jabu nukupwaaga, “Lukwali lubiya kwinu!”
Ndipala ampwagila Tomasi, “Beka lukonzi lwaku pambani gulinga maboku gangu, nyosa kuboku kwaku gulinga muluteta lwangu. Kotuka kuba ni kiholu, ila guhobaliya.”
Tomasi ampwagila, “Bambu wangu na Sapanga wangu!”
Yesu ampwagila, “Boo gunhobali le egumwene? Nambanga banga kubona, lakini ahobale.”
Ndaba jukuandika kitabu senze
Yesu jatenda nginyuli nga yeyo mbeli ja banafunzi baki, yeyuye ngaseaandiki mukitabu senzeno.
Lakini ganiaga aandiki ili nnwesa kunhobale Yesu ndi Kilisitu Nkombosi, Mwana waka Sapanga, na sukunhobale jombi, mwanganya mwiipata womi wa masoba goa kwa makili gi liina laki.
